scenes.name: QUESTION
lines: Start with x times x plus one times x plus two: its x-squared coefficient is three.
先看 x 乘 x 加一再乘 x 加二：x 平方的系数是三。
The paper places these Stirling numbers in a determinant and asks why a nested sum reproduces it.
论文把这些斯特林数放进行列式，并追问嵌套和为什么会重现它。

scenes.name: THE BRIDGE
lines: A triangular change of polynomial basis turns the coefficient matrix into a fixed alphabet: one through N.
多项式基的三角换基，把系数矩阵变成固定字母表：从一到 N。
The determinant is the rectangular Schur polynomial s of k by m, evaluated on that alphabet.
行列式就是 k 乘 m 矩形的舒尔多项式，在这个字母表上取值。
Its tableaux are legal fillings of a box rectangle, so positivity and integrality become visible.
它的半标准杨表就是方格矩形的合法填法，因此正性和整数性变得直观。

scenes.name: THE SQUARE
lines: The alternant chooses m numbers and divides by differences between chosen and unchosen numbers.
交替行列式选出 m 个数字，再除以选中与未选中数字之间的差。
Pairing those differences leaves a squared Vandermonde product, exactly the square in the nested sum.
把这些差配对，就留下范德蒙德平方，正是嵌套和里的平方。
The substitution a sub t equals n minus j sub t plus t turns increasing subsets into decreasing chains.
换元 a 下标 t 等于 n 减 j 下标 t 加 t，把升序子集变成下降链。

scenes.name: CORRECTION
lines: At n equals m equals k equals one, the determinant is three.
当 n、m、k 都等于一时，行列式是三。
Extending the undefined printed weights by zero gives one. The corrected weights give minus one plus two times two, which is three.
把印刷公式未定义的权重补成零会得到一；修正后是负一加二乘二，等于三。
The same alphabet issue changes a second-kind value from the printed twenty-five to the correct seven.
同样的字母表问题，把第二类的印刷值二十五改回正确的七。

scenes.name: RECIPROCALS
lines: For positive n and m, now allow every integer exponent.
当 n 与 m 都为正数时，允许指数取任意整数。
Between minus m and n the alternant has two equal rows, so the value vanishes.
在负 m 与 n 之间，交替行列式有两行相同，所以值为零。
At the negative branch, invert every variable; nm cross differences create the sign, and complementary rectangles explain the new Schur polynomial.
在负指数分支，把每个变量取倒数；nm 个交叉差产生符号，互补矩形解释新的舒尔多项式。
At exponent minus m minus one, this becomes Kurkov's second nested identity in A132393.
指数取负 m 减一时，就得到 Kurkov 在 A132393 中的第二条嵌套恒等式。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: The two literal nested identities are frozen Lean theorems; the Schur extension and corrections remain written mathematics in this paper.
两条逐字嵌套恒等式是冻结的 Lean 定理；舒尔推广和修正仍是本文的书面数学。
The lesson is one chain: determinant, Schur polynomial, Vandermonde square, and reciprocal powers.
故事只有一条链：行列式、舒尔多项式、范德蒙德平方与倒数幂。
